# Document AI & OCR

**Get text, tables, and fields out of scans and PDFs: image cleanup, classic OCR engines, handwriting recognition, layout-aware models, PDF-to-Markdown tools, and vision-language models that read pages directly.**

Level: **Intermediate** · 10 steps · 3h 35m of video · Prerequisites: [Machine Learning](machine-learning.md) and [Deep Learning](deep-learning.md). [Computer Vision](computer-vision.md) helps for the handwriting and layout steps. The last two steps run 3B-7B vision-language models, so use a GPU or Colab there.

[Track your progress on the website](https://gruheshkurra.github.io/awesome-ai-roadmaps/document-ai-and-ocr/) · [All roadmaps](../README.md)

## Build it

- Photograph 20 receipts, clean them with OpenCV, run two OCR engines, and report each one's character error rate against your own transcriptions.
- Convert 10 PDFs with tables into Markdown using Docling and Marker, and write up where each one broke a table or the reading order.
- Fine-tune LayoutLM on the FUNSD forms dataset to label questions and answers, and report per-label F1.

**Next:** [Self-Supervised & Contrastive Learning](self-supervised-and-contrastive-learning.md)
